title: A Postcards for the Language
author: Cyrus Nystrom
blurb: Ansel Villalobos, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
